title: Winter Chickpea and Silverbeet Stew
subtitle: with leek, garlic and lemon
description: A vegan pot stew of cooked chickpeas, silverbeet, fried leek, garlic and lemon. Serve it with rice.

steps.text: Soak the chickpeas in plenty of water overnight.
Finely chop the white stems of the silverbeet and tear the green leaves by hand. Chop the leek and garlic, and juice the lemon.
Cook the chickpeas for about 50 minutes until tender, skimming as needed. Drain and transfer to a bowl.
Heat 5-6 tablespoons of olive oil in a deep pan and fry the leek for 10-15 minutes until translucent.
Add the garlic and fry for 2-3 minutes, making sure it does not burn.
Add the chopped silverbeet stems and fry for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the cumin and mix well. Add the chickpeas and fry for 2 more minutes.
Add the silverbeet leaves and, once they begin to wilt, add the stock and lemon juice. Mix well.
Keep cooking uncovered until the liquid reduces to your liking (about 50 minutes on medium-low heat). Season with salt and adjust the flavours.
